result.title: From Acting to Learning: Experience Selection toward Continually Learning Agents
result.summary: Successful agent interactions provide training data, but success alone does not determine which records a student should learn from. We examine experience selection for a 4B language agent as a component of continual agent learning. Nine selectors are compared across two fixed experience pools, eight initialization seeds, and two sampling seeds, yielding 288 trained students. Each student is evaluated on 128 development task groups with a common executor. With equal global selection freedom, 256 distinct contents, and 768 training presentations, optimizer-aware gradient selection reaches 81.45\% and 73.19\% success in the two pools. Its gains over global random selection are 8.25 and 5.96 percentage points; gains over global high-NLL selection are 4.10 and 4.05 points. All eight initialization-level contrasts are positive against both baselines in each pool. Relaxing coverage constraints improves gradient selection but reduces random-selection performance, showing that the ranking rule and selection space must be considered together. A separately frozen replication on 128 reserved task groups is complete; its equal-source gradient-minus-random and gradient-minus-high-NLL differences are +7.03 and +5.03 points, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究持续学习智能体的「经验选择」：在固定经验池、多随机种子下比较九种选择器训练 4B 语言智能体，发现考虑优化器的梯度选择优于全局随机与高 NLL 选择，并强调排序规则须与选择空间共同考虑。
AI.relevance_reason: 同属「用哪些交互记录来训练」的问题，其梯度式贡献分配线索可能可供核查 LVR 轨迹训练与监督贡献分配，但材料未涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理。
